CheckTitle: Ensure VPC Flow Logging is Enabled in all VPCs
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that every VPC has at least one active flow log.
Risk: Without flow logs, network-level reconnaissance, lateral movement and exfiltration cannot be detected or investigated.

Code.CLI: aws ec2 create-flow-logs --resource-type VPC --resource-ids <vpc> --traffic-type ALL --log-destination-type s3 --log-destination <bucket-arn>

Recommendation.Text: Enable VPC flow logs (at least REJECT traffic, preferably ALL) to CloudWatch Logs or S3.
